player_prompt.intro:
I {player_id} na Player i ni **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**-ah.
I che vel dan tur chu **[macro  micro]** (number 2 0-8 inkar):
• *macro*  = mini-board eng nge i khelh dawn
• *micro* = mini-board chhunga square eng nge i khelh dawn
Entirnan `[7 8]` ➜ mini-board 7, square 8-ah i mark dah ang a,
mini-board 8-ah i khingpui i khelhtir ang.

I ni `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Move chu 0-8 a awm [macro micro] anga siam tûr a ni.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Index hi 0 leh 8 inkarah a awm tur a ni.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row emaw col chu a awm lo.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: A cell chu an luah tawh a ni.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Player chuan micro board dawttuah a khelh tûr a ni.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Micro board chu a ni tawh.

game_action.played: Player {player_id} micro board {macro_idx}-ah cell {micro_idx} (row {row}, col {col}) a khel. Player {opponent_id} chuan {nxt_txt}-ah a khel tur a ni.

outcome.win: Player {player_id} chuan Ultimate Tic Tac Toe a hneh!
